name: patterns-and-refactoring
description: Forces a deliberate design decision before non-trivial code is written, a test-backed process before code is restructured, a structured review of someone else's abstractions, and an audit of what was actually built. Ships the patterns-and-refactoring skill: 22 GoF patterns, 66 refactoring techniques, 22 code smells, enterprise/architectural/DDD/distributed/concurrency/functional/frontend/security/data-evolution/delivery/API-design catalogues, anti-patterns, testing patterns, decision templates and framework idioms for 22 stacks.
